   times). The addition was 5% of the well, nothing mixed the well afterwards, and the run
   ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so
   what the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated. A PCR plate is usually
   vortexed and spun down before cycling; if this one will not be, mix it.

   `mix_after=(5, 16)` on the transfer, or `pipette.mix(5, 16, well)`, with the volume about
   80% of what the well holds.

findings.title: No no-template control: 24 wells of dntp with a sample

findings.title: 12 wells never mixed after rt went in (5% of the well)
findings.explanation: At line 79 the robot added rt to wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4, which already held water, buffer, dntp, primers and 12 more (this line did it 12 times). The addition was 5% of the well, nothing mixed the well afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at the concentration you calculated. A PCR plate is usually vortexed and spun down before cycling; if this one will not be, mix it.
